'''Grav-cranes''' were a vehicle produced by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] which were in use shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Condensation gathered on a grav-crane and dripped onto the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] while he was working for the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Akris Ur'etu]] attempting to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Unidentified Hutt enforcer|imposter]] hired to kill Akris.<ref name="Rep" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grav-cranes were first mentioned in the short story ''[[Reputation (Cad Bane)|Reputation]]'' written by
[[Ari Marmell]] and illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]] which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 136]] in [[2012]].
